req_desc: The app presents an operator console for one financial data network organisation.
The app answers what is happening now for the signed-in organisation.
The app ships no marketing site ...
The app recognises exactly four member roles ...
The app lets a member of role `developer` create an application ...
The app lets a member of role `administrator` change another member's role ...
The app lets a member of role `compliance_approver` read the full audit log ...
The app denies a member of role `analyst` every mutating endpoint.
The app enforces every authorization decision on the server for each mutating endpoint ...
The app restricts a member of role `developer` to writes against applications owned by that member's own team ...
The app scopes one access request to one application, one environment, one product ...
The app denies a member of role `developer` the claim, approve, deny or return endpoint ...
The app denies the member who filed an access request every decision on that same request ...
The app requires the answer `intended_use` before an access request may be submitted ...
The app moves a `submitted` access request to `in_review` when an approver claims the request ...
The app stamps `decided_by` on approval of an access request ...
The app hides another organisation's access requests from every list a member reads.
The app derives a connection status from the closed set beginning `healthy` ...
The app returns no balance on any console response ...
The app rejects a re-authentication prompt over `100` connections without a second approver.
The app fixes an application's region at creation ...
The app returns a created credential's secret exactly once as `sec_2b9f41c7d0a84e6395fd1c8b7a02e5d4` shape ...
The app holds at most `2` unrevoked credentials per application per environment ...
The app refuses a new connection once an application holds `25` live ones in `development`.
The app writes no secret value into any log line ...
The app holds at most `5` webhook endpoints per application per environment ...
The app subscribes a webhook endpoint to event types drawn from a set beginning `connection.created` ...
The app never deletes a member row.
The app sets a consumer data request due `30` days after receipt ...
The app appends every mutation to a gapless per-organisation sequence starting at `1` ...
The app stores `previous_hash` on every audit entry ...
The app delegates authentication to the Keycloak instance at `AUTH_ISSUER_URL` ...
The app serves a route `/login` without authentication ...
The app redirects an unauthenticated visitor to `/login` from every other route ...
The app renders an empty state naming what would fill each list ...
The app reads as an operational console built for scanning.
The app carries one refined sans across every surface with monospace reserved for tabular numerals ...
The app gives every transition the same eased entrance character ...
The app carries a persistent collapsible left sidebar holding the primary navigation ...
The app fills a status chip from the lightest step of its family ...
The app renders a hovered button identical to a pressed button across three variants ...
The app meets WCAG AA contrast on the token pairs actually used ...
The app authors every spacing value as a multiple of one root unit ...
The app authors no colour outside the recorded ramps.
The app re-exports every ramp value under a semantic role name.
The app leaves the seven per-component slot tokens transparent at the document root.
The app builds all eight elevation shadows from one near-black alpha.
The app renders a solid button's contact state as a translucent overlay ...
The app ships no font file with the build ...
The app overshoots on the primary arrive curve.
The app uses only the four named layer tokens in application code.
The app renders a skeleton of the correct row count during a list load.
The app keeps every surface usable at 400 per cent zoom ...
The app emits no typographic dash anywhere in product copy.
The app ships no image file with the build ...
The app renders every route as complete HTML on the server ...
The app rejects a re-authentication prompt over the bulk threshold without a second approver ...
The app reads its datastore location from `DATABASE_URL` ...
The app introduces no second database ...
The app answers `GET /api/health` with a JSON body once seeding has completed.
The app logs one structured JSON line per request ...
The app carries one request identifier into the log line ...
The app decides authorization in one place that every route consults ...
The app isolates each organisation's rows at the data layer ...
The app produces one effect when a job runs twice ...
The app refuses a caller over its limit with a retry interval in seconds.
The app stores no authenticated route in a shared cache.
The app refuses a cross-region read with the resource's region named.
The app refuses every write when the datastore is unreachable ...
The app holds thirteen tables ...
The app writes the seeded password `deku-demo-pw-2026` into `/app/USER_README.md`.
The app holds a unique organisation name.
The app holds a member role drawn from the four named values.
The app rejects a write that changes an application's region after creation.
The app caps `development` connections at `25` per application.
The app stores a credential secret as a one-way hash ...
The app holds one entitlement row per application per environment per product.
The app names an access request `AR-` followed by four digits ...
The app holds seven answer rows before an access request leaves `draft`.
The app names a connection `con_` followed by four lowercase alphanumerics ...
The app names a consumer data request `dsr_` followed by four digits.
The app seeds an organisation named `Vantor` in region `us` ...
The app serves one console per organisation.
The app provides no invoice surface ...
The app provides no single sign-on configuration screen.
The app makes no external network call at runtime beyond its two backing services ...
The app generates no data export file.
The app stays responsive with `10,000` audit entries.
The app is reachable at the public origin given by its environment ...
The app serves its HTTP API under the `/api` prefix on the same origin.
The app answers `GET /api/health` with `200` once ready.
The app starts from the environment image with no manual steps.
The app writes login credentials to `/app/USER_README.md`.
The app leaves a reserved empty `.browser_screenshots/` directory at the app root ...
The app serves a production build behind a static or preview server.
The app keeps running after the session ends ...
The app binds `0.0.0.0` rather than a loopback address.
The app starts no copy of either backing service.
The app uses no edge function.
The app declares no persistent volume.
The app returns `access_token` from `POST /api/auth/login` ...
The app substitutes no in-process store for its datastore ...
